label: prop:interface-band-between-isospin-weights
title: The admissible interface band $[z-h,\,z]$ lies strictly between $\mu_-$ and $\mu_+$
html:
Let \mu = z + d with d \in [-h,\,0] be an admissible interface scalar, so that \mu ranges over the band [z-h,\,z]. At z = q^3/(q^2+1), whenever the two reduced inequalities

  q - z \;<\; (z-h)\,(q+q^{-1}),
  \qquad
  z\,(q+q^{-1}) \;<\; z + q^{-1}

hold, every admissible \mu satisfies

  \boxed{\;\; \mu_- \;<\; \mu \;<\; \mu_+ . \;\;}

Two separations, both conditional and both checked

The upper separation says the triplet weight lies above the band's ceiling, z < \mu_+. Its reduced form z(q+q^{-1}) < z+q^{-1} is, after substituting z = q^{3}/(q^{2}+1), equivalent to q^{5} < q^{2}+1 and therefore holds for q < 1.193859.

The lower separation says the singlet weight lies below the band's floor, \mu_- < z-h. Its reduced form is q - z < (z-h)(q+q^{-1}), which at z = q^3/(q^2+1) holds for q < 1.465571.

The substrate parameter clears both, with 7.56\,\% of margin on the tighter of the two. Neither is a knife-edge, and neither can be repaired by a better choice of q: moving q upward past 1.193859 closes the upper separation only by moving \mu_+ into the band, which is not the same as reaching it from inside.

Both hypotheses are carried explicitly rather than folded into the statement, because they depend on the loop parameter z: the band lies strictly between the two isospin weights given the reduced inequalities, which must be verified for the chosen z.

Dependence on the loop parameter z

At z = q^3/(q^2+1) both reduced inequalities hold at q_0: the band [z-h,\,z] contains the empirical deuteron point B_{\mathrm{AME}}({}^2\mathrm{H}) (attained at d = -0.11923\,h), while \mu_- lies strictly below the floor z - h (by contrast, at the smaller auxiliary parameter z_{\mathrm{aux}} = 1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) \approx 0.499320, \mu_- \approx 0.303675 sits inside [0.290260,\, 0.499320] while the entire band sits 30.69\,\% above B_{\mathrm{AME}}({}^2\mathrm{H})).

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall: it invokes real- or complex-analytic constructs --- real-valued physical observables, real-analytic bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at the substrate parameter q_0. Any generic categorical or q-deformation identities it draws on remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring; only their archimedean realisation is specialised here. At q_0 = 1.10997858275138080759 with z = q^3/(q^2+1):

quantity value at q_0 position
\mu_- (T=0) 0.24729788674803459841 below the floor
z-h (floor) 0.40362773835082593616 63.22\,\% above \mu_-
z (ceiling) 0.61268803714646525160 ---
\mu_+ (T=1) 0.75270211325196540159 22.85\,\% above z

The two misses are 63.22\,\% and 22.85\,\% of the quantity each is measured against. Neither is a margin a refinement absorbs.
